mapper.select: SELECT tag_id, tag_name, use_count, create_time FROM article_tag WHERE tag_name = #{tagName} LIMIT 1
SELECT tag_id AS tagId, tag_name AS tagName, use_count AS useCount FROM article_tag WHERE tag_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY use_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT tag_id AS tagId, tag_name AS tagName, use_count AS useCount FROM article_tag WHERE use_count > 0 ORDER BY use_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.tag_id AS tagId, t.tag_name AS tagName, t.use_count AS useCount FROM article_tag t INNER JOIN article_tag_relation r ON t.tag_id = r.tag_id WHERE r.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY r.id ASC
